instruction: Rotate the berry image 90 degrees clockwise.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully flipped berry image horizontally in GIMP using Image > Transform > Flip Horizontally in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus, use Image > Transform operations, perform image manipulations
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed model can use Image > Transform menu. Rotation is in the same Transform submenu the agent already navigated, at similar difficulty.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to rotate berry image 90 degrees clockwise. Original image is 1280x851, so after 90 CW rotation dimensions become 851x1280. Evaluator exports via postconfig and uses check_image_size to verify swapped dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly fetches the exported rotated image from /home/user/Desktop/berry_rotated.png.
Postconfig correctly exports the GIMP image using Shift+Ctrl+E, types filename 'berry_rotated', and confirms export dialogs.
Metric (check_image_size) correctly receives the rules dict directly and checks width=851, height=1280, which are the correct swapped dimensions for a 90-degree rotation of a 1280x851 image.
Expected dimension values (851x1280) are semantically correct for a 90-degree rotation of the original 1280x851 image.

Minor limitation: Dimension check alone cannot distinguish between 90-degree clockwise vs counter-clockwise rotation, as both produce identical 851x1280 dimensions. A pixel-level comparison would be needed to verify rotation direction, but dimension check is a reasonable approximation.

The postconfig export path may not guarantee the file lands at /home/user/Desktop/berry_rotated.png if the export dialog defaults to a different directory, though Desktop is the most likely default given the source file location.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using a pixel-level comparison (e.g., compare a corner pixel of the rotated image against the expected value for CW rotation) to distinguish between CW and CCW rotation, rather than relying solely on dimension checks.
Consider clearing the filename field before typing 'berry_rotated' in the export dialog to avoid appending to existing text.
